correction_to_prior_interpretation.statement: Measured allocated shared memory is not minimum pipeline cache requirement. Three-CTA dispatch itself chooses roughly 76.5KB dynamic per CTA; observing a shared-memory residency limit of three does not prove four-stage minimum cache requires this allocation.
correction_to_prior_interpretation.register_heuristic: 255*1024 bytes divided by numRegs*threads*4. At 128 registers and 128 threads gives 3 instead of ideal integer register-file capacity 4; actual CUDA occupancy accounts for granularity and other constraints.
correction_to_prior_interpretation.provenance: No rationale comment found; local SGLang checkout is shallow. Historical intent of 255KiB remains unknown. Do not assert it was necessarily an upstream bug.

occupancy_only.concurrency_limit: No concurrent host configuration/launch of the same kernel symbol is supported by this candidate. Once-per-search ceiling reduces mutations but existing final launch setter can lower the shared function ceiling between another thread's query and launch. Serialize host dispatch/configuration through launch; persistent initialization/caching is separate future work.

pipeline3_scoped.failure_root_cause: Epilogue reuses B shared storage: assertion reduces to Mblocks*pack_factor <= 2*stages*Kblocks. NVFP4 Mblocks4 Kblocks4 fails at3 stages (32 >24); blanket stage edit instantiates these shapes even when benchmark only exercises smaller blocks.
pipeline3_scoped.repair: Compile-time selector returns3 only SM90 BF16 NVFP4 EP no-bias Mblocks1 with capacity inequality; all others retain4. Host cache and validity calculations receive matching selected depth; dense/global pipe_stages unchanged.
pipeline3_scoped.unproven: Odd ring depth pipeline semantics need GPU oracle; static capacity proof alone is insufficient. Comment about even pipeline length requires caution.
pipeline3_scoped.host_coherence: Template instantiation, A/B/scales/gidx cache sizing, validity checks and occupancy estimate use same depth decision. Final dynamic allocation remains selected block-count budget.
